**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** carries both preferred elements verbatim: "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," plus payment only for Services ordered in an executed Order Form and an express statement that not ordering is neither a breach nor a shortfall.
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** independently blocks any unstated minimum-use charge.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** confirms Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment.
- Searches for "minimum", "shortfall", "commit", "volume", "usage", and "exceed" surfaced no take-or-pay, prepaid-commitment, or usage-cap mechanic; the only "shortfall" references (§§ 22.2–22.3) concern audit underpayment, not a purchase commitment.
- The § 2.2 exclusivity undertaking is a sourcing restriction, not a purchase or volume commitment, and belongs under EXCLUSIVITY — not flagged twice here.

No redline proposed.
